Check the Payslip of a Mid-Month Joiner or Leaver

User manual · English · 12 steps
Learn how to verify the pay of an employee who joins or leaves during the month: check the contract start and end dates, then confirm on the payslip that only the days under contract are paid.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Contracts menu

Open the Contracts menu.

3. Contracts

Click Contracts.

4. Open a group

Click a group to show its contracts.

5. Start date

Look at the Start Date column, then click it to continue.

6. End date

Look at the End Date column, then click it to continue.

7. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

8. All Payslips

Click All Payslips.

9. Open a batch

Click a batch name to show its payslips.

10. Open the payslip

Click the payslip to open it.

11. Worked days and inputs

Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

12. Worked days lines

Compare the days with the contract dates, then click the table to finish.
